newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 50 India pilgrims die in truck accident.
newsitem.headline: At least 50 India pilgrims die in truck accident.

text.p: At least 50 Hindu pilgrims were killed in eastern India when a truck carrying boulders overturned on them, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Tuesday.
The news agency said five people were injured when the truck spilled boulders on the pilgrims, who were returning on Monday night from the temple town of Deoghar in Bihar state.
The victims were buried under the heavy stones, PTI quoted local officials as saying.
The news agency did not say whether the pilgrims were travelling in the truck when it overturned or what caused the accident.
